defects.figma_prompt: Modern TV anime, crisp ink lines, hard cel shading, vivid colour, expressive face. Single image, no panels, no border, no black bars, the picture fills the whole vertical frame. Side view, medium-wide shot on a sunny present-day beach at Mactan, two men only. On the left a lean young Filipino man about twenty, warm brown skin, black hair in a small topknot, plain grey t-shirt, jeans, bare neck with no necklace, red handkerchief on his left wrist, indigo tattoos on his right forearm, holding a kampilan, a long single-edged Filipino sword with a forked tip at the end of a straight blade, with both his hands together on its hilt, swinging it level. On the right, an arm's length away, a man in a black suit holds one raised metal pipe in his own two hands; the glowing gold blade has just passed through the pipe and its upper half breaks off into the air with golden sparks; the man is unhurt and shocked. Each man has exactly two arms and two hands, each hand a thumb and four fingers; only one sword and one pipe in the picture. No dog, no animals. Vertical 9:16. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
defects.fix_note: Redrawn on the free full-quality model (flux-3, 30 steps), chosen from 12 draws in two rounds; seed 2025. Round 1 (seen from behind Indio, 6 draws) failed: blade passing behind his head as if from his chin, hilt at his mouth, an extra arm. Round 2 changed the picture to a wide side view, two full figures in profile: Indio (grey t-shirt, jeans, topknot, red handkerchief on the wrist, as in kalasag_shield/return_rush) lunging with both hands stacked on the hilt, blade level and away from his body; the suited thug holds only the short stub of the pipe in his own right fist, his other hand hidden behind his body, while the cut upper half spins away with sparks. Checked at 3x: Indio two arms, both hands four fingers and thumb on one hilt, one sword; thug one visible hand with a clean grip on the stub, one pipe in two pieces, faces clean, no third figure, no dog. Placed beside kalasag_shield, return_rush, thugs_bars and tubal_price: same Indio and same suits.
defects.judge_note: rejected, old still restored: in the seed-2025 redraw Indio's two arms end in ONE fist on the kampilan hilt. At 3x and 4x (left third, about x 200-340, y 640-750) the near arm with the red handkerchief enters the fist from the left and the far forearm runs down the top of the same fist and merges into its knuckles; there is no second hand anywhere on the hilt (bare pommel to the left, guard to the right). Also off-model against kalasag_shield and return_rush: Indio is drawn with much darker brown skin and a looser, flatter face style, and the sword is a straight gold blade with a cross-guard, not the episode's kampilan (brown wooden grip, forked pommel, as in kampilan_sand). The named fault (Indio holding the pipe himself) was gone, and the thug's hand on the pipe stub, both faces and the pipe pieces were clean, but the merged hands are a new countable fault.
